Public saunas in Los Angeles, CA

Los Angeles has a dense public bathhouse scene: Russian-style banyas in Mid-City and West Hollywood, large Korean spas near Koreatown, and a communal sauna-and-cold-plunge club in Venice. City Spa and Voda sell walk-in day passes for rock rooms, Finnish saunas and cold plunges; Wi Spa and Olympic Spa are classic Korean bathhouses with many heat rooms; Teddy's Hot House runs timed Finnish sauna sessions with ice baths. Prices, hours and co-ed rules change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

5 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-06. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Mon 2pm-10pm; Tue-Fri 10am-10pm; Sat 8am-10pm; Sun 8am-6pm. Co-ed all day Mondays and Wednesdays; co-ed from 2pm Saturdays. 18+. Walk-ins welcome for general spa use; massage needs 24-hour reservation.

Open 24 hours, 7 days a week. No reservation needed for day passes; book treatments ahead. Family-friendly co-ed jimjilbang; gender-segregated spa floors are clothing-optional per venue rules. Guests under 18 need a same-gender adult in spa/sauna areas.
Notes
Korean bathhouse with men's floor, women's floor, co-ed jimjilbang (Bulgama, Salt, Clay, Jade and Ice saunas), rooftop terrace and restaurant. Shirt and shorts provided for co-ed areas; towels and lockers included with admission. Valet parking $4 cash. First Wednesday of each month has overnight maintenance windows.
